title: Builder Withdrawal of a Reserved Homesite — Homesite Reservation Terms
content:
Calloway may withdraw a homesite reserved under a Homesite Reservation from sale (a re-plat, an engineering hold or a model designation) only after sending the buyer a written builder withdrawal notice.

**Notice period.** The homesite may be withdrawn only when at least the class's builder withdrawal notice days have passed since the withdrawal notice was sent. Counting starts the day after the notice date, and withdrawal is allowed on the last counted day. The notice relied on is the builder withdrawal notice entry on that reservation's ledger, and its date is the date the notice was sent.

**Refund on withdrawal.** On withdrawal, every dollar held on the reservation, fees included, is refunded with the refund reason builder withdrawal within the class's builder withdrawal refund business days, and no fee is retained.

**Effect on other rules.** A withdrawal does not count as a release or an expiry for the wait before the same buyer may reserve the same homesite again, and once written it does not count toward the caps on open reservations.

## Notice cases (hypothetical notice period of 3 days, notice sent on 2 October)

| Withdrawal date | Days passed since the notice | Allowed |
|---|---|---|
| 4 October | 2 | No, fewer than 3 days have passed |
| 5 October | 3, the last counted day | Yes |
| 6 October | 4 | Yes |
